description.value: Khanh Express is a family-founded Vietnamese-Cambodian noodle soup restaurant in downtown Vancouver, built as a tribute to the owner's father and his love of pho. The Beatty Street location sits in the heart of a well-connected cycling corridor and offers a broad menu spanning pho, vermicelli, banh mi, and rice dishes with dedicated vegetarian options. Online ordering and a digital loyalty program via LoyLap make it a convenient stop for cyclists passing through the area.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms the Beatty St location address (910 Beatty St, Vancouver, BC V6B 1M7) and phone (604-841-4268), matching OSM tags. The menu page lists a dedicated 'Vegetarian' section corroborating OSM's diet:vegetarian=yes, and 'ORDER ONLINE' links plus mention of mobile ordering confirm takeout. No evidence on the website or in OSM tags addresses bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycling amenities, so those remain null.
concerns: Website header/navigation renders the domain as 'khanhexpress.com' while the OSM URL and fetched URL are 'khanhexpress.ca' — likely a redirect or dual-domain setup, but worth monitoring.
No evidence of bike parking found in website content or OSM tags; this required criterion cannot be confirmed without on-site verification.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, actively operating restaurant in downtown Vancouver on a cycling-accessible street, offering vegetarian options and online ordering — a practical and welcoming food stop for touring cyclists. Bike parking is unconfirmed but the listing is otherwise solid.
